Details
  • Paper: SegNeXt: Rethinking Convolutional Attention Design for Semantic Segmentation, NeurIPS 2022, 2022-09-18
  • Original code: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmsegmentation at c685fe6767c4
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/Visual-Attention-Network/SegNeXt (PyTorch): The mmsegmentation port carries the architecture and the model-zoo checkpoints without the authors' mmsegmentation fork.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmsegmentation/blob/c685fe6767c4cadf6b051983ca6208f1b9d1ccb8/README.md#license
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification), ADE20K (SceneParsing, 150 classes)
  • Kernel libraries: seg_conv, cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3, seg_up
  • Variants: segnext-mscan-t-ade20k, segnext-mscan-s-ade20k, segnext-mscan-b-ade20k, segnext-mscan-l-ade20k
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: ade20k-150
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): segnext-mscan-t-ade20k 1024x2048 (0.4 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); segnext-mscan-s-ade20k 1024x2048 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); segnext-mscan-b-ade20k 1024x2048 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); segnext-mscan-l-ade20k 1024x2048 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved)
  • segnext-mscan-t-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 19 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 60 s (ONNX + engine).
  • segnext-mscan-s-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 17 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 57 s (ONNX + engine).
  • segnext-mscan-b-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 24 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 66 s (ONNX + engine).
  • segnext-mscan-l-ade20k 1024x2048, first call: portable + torch.compile 35 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 82 s (ONNX + engine).
  • segnext-mscan-t-ade20k original (fp32) 1024x2048: mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-t-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-s-ade20k original (fp32) 1024x2048: mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-s-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-b-ade20k original (fp32) 1024x2048: mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-b-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-l-ade20k original (fp32) 1024x2048: mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-l-ade20k original 1024x2048: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmsegmentation 1.2.2 encode_decode, NMF start bases seeded (0) on every call
  • segnext-mscan-t-ade20k load / first call: original 0.19 s / 0.335 s, portable 0.13 s / 0.649 s (512x512), kernels 1.26 s / 0.199 s (512x512)
  • segnext-mscan-s-ade20k load / first call: original 0.23 s / 0.316 s, portable 0.15 s / 0.722 s (512x512), kernels 1.29 s / 0.187 s (512x512)
  • segnext-mscan-b-ade20k load / first call: original 0.37 s / 0.186 s, portable 0.26 s / 0.578 s (512x512), kernels 1.34 s / 0.18 s (512x512)
  • segnext-mscan-l-ade20k load / first call: original 0.57 s / 0.063 s, portable 0.57 s / 0.409 s (512x512), kernels 1.51 s / 0.099 s (512x512)
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5
